messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["lion", "leopard", "eagle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large rearing chimera with the head, rounded ears, full shaggy mane and long tuft-tipped tail of a male lion, two broad fully feathered bird wings spread from its upper back, dense overlapping brown feathers covering the neck and upper chest, and a muscular tan body with dark rosette spots on the torso, hind limbs and tail, standing upright on two powerful hind legs ending in feline paws.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "lion", "part": "head", "where": "at the top front of the body, facing to the right in profile"}, {"looks_like": "lion", "part": "ears", "where": "on the upper sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "lion", "part": "mane", "where": "surrounding the head and upper neck"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "wings", "where": "extending outward from the sides of the upper back, one to the left and one to the right"}, {"looks_like": "eagle", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the neck, upper chest and the entire wings in overlapping brown plumage"}, {"looks_like": "leopard", "part": "legs", "where": "at the lower rear of the body, bent in a rearing stance"}, {"looks_like": "leopard", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the two hind legs"}, {"looks_like": "lion", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear of the lower body, curving down and ending in a dark tuft"}, {"looks_like": "leopard", "part": "markings", "where": "dark rosette spots covering the torso, legs and tail"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
